prompts:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: widescreen 16:9 section-introduction still for a high school AI lesson.
Input image: the attached Why Learn AI screenshot is a photographic style and scene reference, not an interface to reproduce.
Create a realistic editorial photograph matching that reference: a high-school student in a dark green hoodie viewed over their shoulder at a laptop on a wooden library table, softly blurred bookshelves and students behind, warm natural daylight. Real skin, hair, fabric and wood textures; authentic camera photograph with shallow depth of field. Reframe slightly closer to the laptop so its screen occupies most of the right half and is clearly readable in a 720p video; student's head and shoulder remain on the left, looking at the screen.
The laptop screen contains a simple off-white lesson title card, a large dark teal numeral "1" above the exact bold dark teal heading "Hard to Understand and Control", arranged over three balanced lines. This is all the text in the image. Clean sans-serif type, crisp high contrast, perspective aligned within the physical screen, generous margins. No chat UI.
No illustration, no comic, no cartoon, no painted or drawn textures, no halftone. No video player controls, screenshot framing, rounded outer corners, logos or watermark. Full bleed landscape photograph.

Use case: text-localization. Edit only the laptop screen text in the supplied photographic section-intro image. Replace numeral 1 with "2" and replace its heading with exactly "People Can Misuse AI". Keep the same dark teal bold sans-serif type on an off-white screen, similar overall scale, centered with ample margins and balanced line breaks. Maintain photographic perspective on the screen. Preserve the student, identity, pose, hands, hoodie, laptop, room, library, lighting, framing, colors, depth of field, and all other pixels as closely as possible. This must remain a realistic photograph, never a drawing or comic. Full bleed 16:9 landscape, no player controls, no border, no new text or logos.
